name: Validate Dataset (Field-Level)
description: The project's validation primitive — there is no declarative required/datatype/length schema anywhere in the codebase. Evaluates verify.ref (a binding-expression condition, see expressions/binding-expression-dsl.md) and runs whenmatch actions (typically a setdataset into 'snackinfo') when it matches.

verify.halton.description: e.g. "match" — stop validation chain on match.

verify.ref.description: One binding-expression -> expected-value pair, e.g. { "[DsFrmHeaderEntry.FIELD(ifnull)raw.]": "" } checks the field is null/empty.

verify.whenmatch.description: Action array run when the condition matches (i.e. validation failed) — typically raises a snackinfo error.
